बॉलीवुड की पुरानी दोस्ती पर डायरेक्टर का ये बड़ा खुलासा आपको भी हैरान कर देगा! 😲

डायरेक्टर Rajiv Rai ने Vickey Lalwani को दिए इंटरव्यू में बताया कि 1985 की अपनी डेब्यू फिल्म Yudh से उन्होंने Sanjay Dutt को बाहर कर दिया था। Rajiv Rai के मुताबिक, उस वक्त Sanjay Dutt पर्सनल दिक्कतों से जूझ रहे थे, जिसकी वजह से वो काम पूरा नहीं कर सके।

इस एक फैसले की वजह से Sanjay Dutt और Rajiv Rai की सालों पुरानी गहरी दोस्ती टूट गई। Rajiv Rai ने अफसोस जताते हुए कहा कि आज जब वो पीछे मुड़कर देखते हैं, तो लगता है कि उन्हें ऐसा फैसला नहीं लेना चाहिए था। 🎬

बता दें कि Rajiv Rai के पिता Gulshan Rai ने Sunil Dutt के डायरेक्शन वाली फिल्म Rocky को फाइनेंस किया था और दोनों परिवारों में बेहद नजदीकी रिश्ता था। Yudh में Sanjay Dutt की जगह Jackie Shroff को लिया गया, जिसके बाद सिर्फ 20-30% बची फिल्म को दोबारा री-शूट करना पड़ा और Anil Kapoor को भी रीकास्ट किया गया। 🍿

क्या आपको लगता है कि प्रोफेशनल काम के चक्कर में पर्सनल दोस्ती को दांव पर लगाना सही है? कमेंट्स में अपनी राय जरूर दें! 💭

ctx.title: Director Rajiv Rai says replacing Sanjay Dutt in Yudh after actor faced personal issues cost him their friendship
ctx.summary: Rajiv Rai said the decision to replace Sanjay Dutt in Yudh strained their once-close friendship, though Rai said he was unhappy about his decision.
ctx.text:
Filmmaker Rajiv Rai recently opened up about his broken friendship with Sanjay Dutt after he replaced the actor in his directorial debut, Yudh (1985). Speaking to Vickey Lalwani, Rajiv explained that he had to replace Sanjay because the actor was going through personal difficulties at the time.
He said, “ Sanjay Dutt was going through a personal issue for those days and hence I could not complete Yudh with him.” Rajiv shared that his family shared a close bond with the Dutts. His father, Gulshan Rai, had financed Sanjay's debut film, Rocky, which was directed by the actor's father, Sunil Dutt. Rajiv also shared that his father and Sunil Dutt had a close friendship.
While Rajiv's father and Sunil Dutt continued to be friends, Rajiv said that replacing Sanjay in Yudh damaged his friendship with the actor. He said, “We are friends on the surface now, but there is no close friendship anymore. I may have visited his home once or twice after the incident. Before that we had a really deep friendship, which broke. I was not happy making that decision as well. Sometimes, when I think about it I feel I shouldn't have done it.”
Rajiv shared that Sanjay was supposed to play Jackie Shroff's role in the film. However, after he could not complete the film, the entire film had to be reshot, with only 20–30% remaining to be shot. Even Anil Kapoor was recast in the film, the director said.
Released in 1985, Yudh marked Rajiv Rai's directorial debut. Produced by his father, Gulshan Rai, the action thriller starred Jackie Shroff, Anil Kapoor in a double role, Tina Munim, Nutan, Danny Denzongpa and Hema Malini, among others. The film follows a police officer and a lawyer whose lives become intertwined in a story involving kidnapping, crime and family secrets. Rajiv Rai went on to direct films such as Tridev (1989), Vishwatma (1992), Mohra (1994) and Gupt (1997).
Sanjay Dutt has continued to work across Hindi and regional cinema. In 2026, he appeared in films including The Raja Saab, Dhurandhar: The Revenge, Raja Shivaji, Aakhri Sawal and 7 Dogs. He also starred in Haiwaan, released in September 2026. Among his upcoming projects is Khalnayak Returns, a sequel to his 1993 hit Khal Nayak.
